name: manual_15dd7d
claim: Never print a whole provider/settings JSON when inspecting an agent CLI's config (for example Cline providers.json): its auth block holds live access and refresh tokens. Read only named non-secret keys such as model and provider, or print key names only. A leaked token in a transcript means the operator should consider re-authenticating.
conditions: secret token providers.json cline config print redact

decisions.notes: This session's inspection script printed the cline-pass auth block into the transcript by a conditional-expression slip.

rationale: This session's inspection script printed the cline-pass auth block into the transcript by a conditional-expression slip.
